rows.en:
(All right, a whole day on the artificial island
with Sheryl-san!)

Hi~, \p-chan.
Did you manage to sleep last night?
Yes, well, about as usual.
That might be true...
Sheryl-san's taking a while...
Sheryl-san! How long does it take to change...
(Wow~! That's the Galactic Fairy for you!)
Now, let's enjoy our vacation to the fullest!

Come on, \p-chan,
you come over here too.
Oh, you got me! Take thaaat!
Phew, I'm tired~
I'm no match for you, Sheryl-san...
No, I had fun too.
(Sheryl-san seemed different from usual...)

(All right, the artificial island with Sheryl
again today!)

You're late, \p!
Hurry up, let's go! The sea's going to run away!
The sea's going to run away...?
Still pathetic as ever, worn out by just this...
Yeah, I'm ashamed of myself...

Hee hee, you're hopeless.
Make sure you can keep going longer by next time.
(The Galactic Fairy's got amazing stamina too...)

(All right, the artificial island with Sheryl-san
again today!)

You're late, \p-chan!
Hurry up, let's go! The sea's going to run away!
Phew... I'm beeeat...

No, I'm sure it's just that your stamina,
Sheryl-san, is...
rows.notes: Trails off as in the Japanese ('your stamina is [greater]...').

rows.en: (The Galactic Fairy's stamina is amazing too...)

(She said she wanted to "talk somewhere quiet,"
so I invited her to the roof, but what could it
be... Could it be...?)
Oh, you took your time.
Sorry, did I keep you waiting?

No, I was thinking some things over, so
don't worry about it...
So, what did you want to "talk" about?
You know, I'm glad I came to Frontier.
...Yeah.

Away from my work, I met all kinds of people,
saw all kinds of things, learned all kinds
of things...
But that's all over now.

I was only supposed to stay a year at most,
but I selfishly kept dragging it out...
But now time's up...
I have to go back now...
My two years in Frontier were really fun.
Everyone was kind to me, and I made lots of friends.

But I can't just stay here like this...
Because I'm Sheryl... Sheryl Nome.
I see. You're right...

\p,
I'm truly grateful to you.

When I came here to play an ordinary student,
I called out to you because you seemed the most
ordinary. Looks like that was the right call.
Oh, so that's how it was.
Yes. When we first met, anyway.
But now, you're just a little bit special.
Hee hee, just kidding!
Geez, what was that about!

I don't want things getting all teary,
so don't come to see me off, okay?
Aw, you're so cold, geez...
(So it's goodbye to Sheryl...)

(She said she wanted to "talk somewhere quiet,"
so I invited her to the roof, but what could
it be...)
Sorry I kept you waiting.
So, what did you want to "talk" about?
Huh, is that so...
That's... true, I suppose...

\p-chan,
I'm truly grateful to you.
Oh, so that's how it was.
Oh, geez, what was that about!
Oh... don't say that...
(So it's goodbye to Sheryl-san...)
(I asked Sheryl to come to the roof, but...)
Sigh... She's not coming after all...
Well, she's probably already made up her mind...
Oh well, guess I'll head home...
(Sheryl's really going back, isn't she...)
(I asked Sheryl-san to come to the roof, but...)
Sigh... She's not coming after all...
Well, she's probably already made up her mind...
(Sheryl-san's really going back, isn't she...)
